WITH latest AS (
                SELECT
                    max(seq) AS seq
                FROM
                    room_updates
                WHERE
                    room_id = $1
                GROUP BY
                    date_bin($2::interval, created_at, TIMESTAMPTZ 'epoch')
            )
            SELECT
                u.seq AS "covered_through!",
                u.created_at AS "created_at!"
            FROM
                room_updates u
                JOIN latest l ON l.seq = u.seq
            WHERE
                u.room_id = $1
            ORDER BY
                u.seq ASC
